title: الأعياد الرسمية في ليبيا — الكتالوغ الكامل، 2 لغة (1988–2030)
description: Complete catalog of official public, governmental, school, bank, workday, Christian, and Hebrew holidays of Libya (ليبيا) — extracted from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) algorithmic implementation. ليبيا/Libya. State of Libya — independence 1951. Country code: LY. Categories: public, workday. Multilingual names (2 languages: ar, en_US). End-of-string `(estimated)/(observed)` parentheticals stripped from name columns and lifted into per-record `is_estimated`/`is_observed` boolean flags (per-language regex). No subdivisions — single national list.
